## Change and phase

Describe the resulting behavior and authorized phase. Phase 1 requires owner review of Phase 0 first.

## Validation

State actual commands/results and any pending gates. Do not equate skipped checks with acceptance.

## Public content and security

Confirm the staged diff is public-safe, with no private specification/corpus/packages/secrets/logs.
Record significant ADRs, state/task updates, security implications and owner decisions needed.
